location_description: Royal Oak is a city in Oakland County in the U.S. state of Michigan. An inner-ring suburb of Detroit, Royal Oak is about 3 miles (4.8 km) north of Detroit's city limits. As of the 2010 census, the city had a population of 57,236.Royal Oak is located along the Woodward Corridor, and is served by Interstate 75 and Interstate 696.
